reviews.title: works perfectly in my Alienware Aurora 12
reviews.comment: Wanted to take my computer up to 32 gb and this kit matched well with what came with the computer.
reviews.author: Melanie B.

reviews.title: Good Product
reviews.comment: Funny fact I bought these 2x8GB RAM STICKS back in 2022 under $100 Before prices skyrocketed . Never used still in case. But crazy thing is I also bought a single 32GB stick and didn’t know it until I popped open my HP Omen 40L and check one of the RAM slots . 2x8GB=16GB and 1x32GB =48GB . I really didn’t know anything about PCs back then.
reviews.author: Tj
